description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}.
Workshop Assistant dies, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying at most {1}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
Junk Diver dies, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying at most {1}.
Repeat.
